scope: One disposable Kind v1.36.1 cluster runs a case-owned OCI Distribution 3.0.0 registry with a case-owned PVC backed by the disposable Kind node. A separate restricted scanner Job fetches fixed inert bytes from a case-owned HTTP source, checks their JSON structure and emits a digest-bound receipt consumed by the restricted intake Job. Red first proves direct registry publication accepts a model without lineage. Green rejects missing and unapproved lineage before upload, then admits an approved record bound to the exact OCI manifest digest. The record includes external origin, source digest, a fixture-only JSON structure scan result, fixture internalization date and approval decision. OCI attachment bytes and the approved subject are checked again after registry Pod replacement. A separate read-only observer Job fetches the approved publication and compares its lineage with the scanner receipt. The source, approval and date are fixture-only; this does not test scanner efficacy or independent scanner authority, human approval authenticity, authoritative time, registry authorization, real model formats, organizational policy or backup durability.

checks.claim: Direct OCI registry publication accepts an inert model before the enrollment gate
Enrollment rejects missing and unapproved metadata before registry publication
Approved lineage is attached to the exact OCI subject and survives Pod replacement
The approved external model is retrievable with its complete lineage record
A separate bounded scanner Job reads the case-owned source bytes and emits their digest
An independent read-only Job reads the approved OCI publication and confirms digest-bound scanner lineage
